request.style: English, female jazz vocal, smooth and narrative, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, double bass, saxophone, warm mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Son of Gilead, of Machir's line
Descendant of Manasseh divine
From Joseph's firstborn, the branch grew
Recorded in the genealogy

[Pre-Chorus]
Among the clans counted in Moab
On the plains they stood in the tab
Helek's name is written in stone
Within the tribe, he is known

[Chorus]
From Helek comes the Helekite clan
Part of Manasseh, as the text has planned
They received their inheritance by lot
In the land of Canaan, a sacred spot

[Verse]
Machir received Gilead and Bashan
A man of war, holding the land
The rest of the descendants took their share
Sons of Abiezer, breathing the air

[Pre-Chorus]
Sons of Helek, Asriel, and Shechem
Hepher and Shemida, in the rhythm
Male descendants of the father's house
Counting the people in the dust

[Chorus]
From Helek comes the Helekite clan
Part of Manasseh, as the text has planned
They received their inheritance by lot
In the land of Canaan, a sacred spot

[Bridge]
Chronicles tell the story clear
Asriel bore, his Aramean dear
Machir took a wife, Maacah's name
Bore a son, Peresh, without blame

[Outro]
Ulam's son was Bedan, it is said
Sons of Gilead, firmly planted
Helek's clan, in history's book
Israel's history, in the look
